sc: Fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, Koplik spots, rash from the face down on day 4 → Measles
Infant, 3 days of high fever, rash appears as the fever falls → Roseola (HHV-6)
Sore throat, sandpaper rash, circumoral pallor, strawberry tongue → Scarlet fever
f: Prodrome 3–4 days (3 Cs) → Koplik spots (pathognomonic) → rash from face downward · infectious 4 days before to 4 days after the rash
Pneumonia (commonest cause of death) · otitis · diarrhoea · encephalitis · corneal ulcer · SSPE 7–10 years later
Vitamin A day 1 and 2 · supportive · treat complications · MR vaccine at 9 and 18 months
Chickenpox: itchy vesicles in crops, all stages · parvovirus: slapped cheeks, lacy rash · rubella: post-auricular nodes
Mumps: parotitis, orchitis, meningitis · EBV: tonsillitis, splenomegaly, atypical lymphocytes
trap: "Tonsillitis" + rash after amoxicillin = infectious mononucleosis, not allergy · sickle cell child with sudden anaemia and low retics → parvovirus aplastic crisis · fever persisting after the measles rash → complication
